title: Health & Damage
summary: Any Damage subtracts, clamps, and branches on death.
when_to_use: Use this when damage should change health in one place and a branch should hear death.
common_mistakes: A common mistake is to subtract health on Tick, or to forget the authority check before Replication.

nodes.note: Any Damage runs on the server. This sample hit is 100, which is enough to empty a full bar.
Read health before you write it. The next node subtracts the incoming damage from this.
Health minus damage. Do this on the server. The client only shows the result.
Max health is the ceiling. Healing later clamps to this same number.
Zero is the floor. Health should not go negative.
Clamp keeps the result between 0 and Max Health.
Write the clamped value back. One Set, after the math, not inside the branch.
Death is health equal to zero after the clamp. Check the new value, not the raw damage.
Then is death. Else is still standing. Put ragdoll or a respawn on Then, not on the damage event itself.
A print stands in for the death function. Replace it with the real call when you leave the sample.
